decisions.reason: The mobile check-in app supports contactless passenger handling and can complement the firm's airport security offering, but adoption was likely slowed by the 2020-2021 aviation downturn.

As an explicitly branded passenger-processing technology launched in late 2019, it appears to be a strategic airport automation product that a large firm would likely carry forward into the sector's recovery.
A self-service airline check-in solution fits airports' need for efficiency and lower staffing intensity, so it is likely to be retained even if commercial rollout was delayed.
